en.template: Help me choose a laptop for {course}, starting {start}, with a hard all-in budget of {budget} and a {commute}. In June–early July 2027, reprice ASUS TUF FA506NCG-HN200WS first and Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9 83GS000PIN as a conditional backup, alongside suitable contemporary exact SKUs. Check {software}, {entitlements}, 16 GB RAM and a documented 32 GB upgrade route. Include a supported OS, eligible warranty/ADP, accessories, taxes and delivery in the upfront total. Keep dated examples separate from confirmed offers, do not assume cashback or certification, and ask before contacting a seller, submitting verification or buying anything.

phases.title: Read the software makers' requirements and collect dated Indian laptop prices, warranty terms and offers
phases.note: Software requirements, exact models with prices, warranty and offers
phases.judgment: It flagged a catch many buying lists miss: SolidWorks' published requirements exclude Windows Home, so a gaming laptop that ships with Home cannot be called fully supported, whatever its graphics card.

phases.title: Write the guide and compare the total cost of each model, with the arithmetic shown
phases.note: Total cost with warranty and extras, and whether to buy now or wait
phases.judgment: It declined to give a confident buy-now answer: no fully supported, fully protected set-up under ₹85,000 could be established. It advises waiting until June–early July 2027 and treats every price as a dated example, not an offer.

phases.title: Independent audit of every figure, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed every money figure and found no arithmetic errors, but also found three statements in the guide that the source list did not support. They were repaired and checked again.

workers: Read the published system requirements for SolidWorks, Fusion, MATLAB and Ansys Student
Found exact laptop models sold in India and noted their dated prices from official stores and major retailers
Checked extended-warranty and accidental-damage costs and the student and bank offers that appear for four brands
Recomputed every money figure independently and checked each claim in the guide against its sources
